caption: The drawing features a single curved sickle with a wooden handle and a dark metallic blade occupying the central area of a plain, light beige background. The sickle's handle is brown and tapers toward the end, while the blade is long, slender, and sharply curved, transitioning from the handle's base in a smooth arc. Additionally, there is a small rectangular label positioned above the blade to the right, colored in brown with some white text or markings that are not fully legible. The artist’s signature “Frank N. Gray” appears in small red text near the bottom left corner. The composition is minimal, with the focus on the detailed rendering of the sickle and minimal use of other objects or colors.
title: Wrought Iron Sickle
